title: Create
description: Adds a new Markdown file to the sidebar without closing your current document.

title: Open
description: Import a .md file or a WorkFlow container (.mdu.json).

title: Save
description: Export as Markdown, PDF via print, or a full WorkFlow backup.

title: How to Use
description: Starts this guided tour. The app never runs it automatically.

title: Diagnostics
description: Inspect recent structured events from the in-app flight recorder.

title: Workspace
description: Files and folders, newest first. Right-click for folder actions; drag to reorder or nest.

title: Preview
description: Split view: edit source on the left, rendered output on the right.

title: Editor
description: Right-click here for formatting shortcuts. Both modes stay editable.

title: Quick formats
description: One-click inserts for common Markdown constructs.
